method: Built-in image_gen edit, one call per portrait

edits.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent square bust portrait for the existing SIGMA 2040 game.
Input image 1: the ORIGINAL portrait of iris, the edit target and sole identity reference.
Primary request: extract exactly this existing character onto a genuinely transparent background. Remove the entire textured red/navy/blue background and all red and blue rim glow / colored edge lighting on hair, face, neck, clothing and shoulder outlines. Replace ONLY such colored lighting with neutral natural highlights matching the existing central portrait light. Retain the natural colors of garments, skin, hair and accessories.
Identity invariants: Iris: silver bob hair, gold hoop earrings, white blazer with triangular gold pin, black scarf blouse, same serious expression. Preserve the exact face, age, facial proportions, eye direction, expression, hairstyle, pose, clothing, accessories and detailed painted illustration style of the target. Do not redesign or beautify the character.
Composition: square canvas, same head-and-chest crop, subject scale and position as input. Keep all visible hair, glasses, earrings and shoulders. Chest continues flush to the bottom edge, as in the original. Preserve the original top margin; no added padding, zoom or reposing.
Background/alpha: every pixel outside the character has alpha 0, including gaps between hair strands and accessories. Fine clean antialiased hair edges; no backdrop remnants, opaque dark matte, checkerboard baked into image, solid fill, shadow or outer glow. No red/blue outline or colored fringe. No new objects, text, watermark or border. Output ONE portrait of this character only.
